question: Which of the following is NOT a regional name for the full or part of the East Coast of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malabar coast**__.

• The Western Ghats:

 
 
• The western ghat is the mountain range parallel to the western coast of the Indian peninsula.
 
• The total length of the western ghat is around 1600 km.
 
• The western ghat region is spread from Tapti to Kanyakumari.
 
• It passes through the Indian states of Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Goa, Maharashtra, and Gujarat.
 
• **Anamudi is the highest peak of the western ghat.**
